title: The cell surface shapes development
summary: Biologist Ernest Everett Just showed the fundamental role of the cell surface and the layer beneath it in the development of organisms, working partly in European labs.
why: Anticipated later work on how the cell's outer layers steer development.

unsung.contribution: Showed the fundamental role of the cell surface in the development of organisms.
unsung.recognition: His experimental work was largely ignored; racism kept him confined to an under-funded post.
